title: Amber Curiosity Cabinet: Silk Pouf Display Configurator
description: The user curates a luxury curiosity cabinet scene where a MosquitoInAmber specimen floats above a SpecularSilkPouf pedestal. Through a multi-step interaction sequence, the user adjusts amber glow intensity, pouf fabric specularity, spotlight color, levitation height, rotation speed, and scene fog to compose and export a final glamour shot.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads both SpecularSilkPouf.glb and MosquitoInAmber.glb from their paths. Scene setup: place the silk pouf at world origin on a reflective dark marble ground plane (MeshStandardMaterial, roughness 0.1, metalness 0.8). Float the mosquito-in-amber model 1.2 units above the pouf center, slowly rotating on Y-axis. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2.5, 5) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Lighting: one warm SpotLight (0xFFD080) angled down at the amber from above-right, one cool RimLight (0x8080FF) from behind-left, and a dim AmbientLight (0x222222). Add subtle exponential fog (0x0a0a12). Build an HTML/CSS control panel (fixed, top-right, semi-transparent dark background, 260px wide) with these validated interactive controls: (1) a range slider 'Amber Emission' (0.0–3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) that adjusts emissiveIntensity on all amber model materials; (2) a range slider 'Silk Specularity' (0.0–1.0, step 0.05, default 0.3) that sets metalness on pouf materials; (3) a color picker 'Spotlight Tint' (default #FFD080) that changes the spotlight color in real time; (4) a range slider 'Levitation Height' (0.5–3.0, step 0.1, default 1.2) that animates the amber model Y-position smoothly via lerp; (5) a range slider 'Rotation Speed' (0.0–5.0, step 0.25, default 1.0) controlling amber Y-axis rotation in radians/sec; (6) a range slider 'Fog Density' (0.0–0.15, step 0.005, default 0.04) adjusting scene fog density; (7) a 'Capture Snapshot' button that calls renderer.domElement.toDataURL and opens the image in a new tab. Validate all numeric inputs are within range before applying. Use requestAnimationFrame loop with delta-time for rotation. Ensure responsive canvas with window resize handling. Add a subtle particle dust effect using a BufferGeometry Points system with 200 small translucent particles drifting slowly upward around the amber to enhance the mystical cabinet atmosphere.
